title: Implement cache-aware microcompact behavior
objective: Preserve prompt-cache-stable message prefixes during microcompaction by implementing the original cache_edits-style path.
context: Go microcompact currently replaces old tool result content locally.
The original avoids mutating cached prefixes while the prompt cache is still alive by using cache_edits and cache_reference.
Go compact package already marks cached microcompact as a known missing area.
deliverables: Add a ContentReplacementState equivalent that freezes replacement decisions.
Distinguish idle-expired local clearing from cache-preserving clearing.
Generate cache_edits and cache_reference blocks for Anthropic when cache is active.
Place cache_edits blocks according to API constraints.
Reset cache break baseline after legitimate compaction events.
Keep non-Anthropic providers on the safe local replacement path.
acceptance: When cache is active, API messages retain the same local message prefix bytes.
When idle threshold expires, local clearing can proceed.
Tests cover duplicate cache_reference prevention and cache_edits placement.
non_goals: Do not rewrite the full context compaction summary system.
Do not change tool execution semantics.
Do not expose user-facing cache warnings by default.
handoff_notes: This task has API-shape risk; add provider-level serialization tests before changing loop behavior.
